latest_release.name: v0.6.1 - Rule-based fidelity guidance
latest_release.body:
Sharper cloning guidance that catches more fidelity drift with fewer, more general directives.

- Treat each observation as a sample of a rule: read declared values and vary viewport width (including wider than the design), height, input, and state.
- Use the files the source actually loads, and build shared components and page-wide behavior, such as smooth scrolling, from every observed state.
- Compare beyond the design width and judge scroll and pointer behavior with real input.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/JCodesMore/ai-website-cloner-template/compare/v0.6.0...v0.6.1

# AI Website Cloner Template ### Clone any website with one command Give your AI coding agent a URL and watch it recreate the website as a clean Next.js app. **Best results with [Claude Code](https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/claude-code) + Opus 5.5. Also supports Codex, Cursor, and OpenCode.** [![Use this template](https://img.shields.io/badge/Use_this_template-Create_your_copy-2ea44f?style=for-the-badge&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/JCodesMore/ai-website-cloner-template/generate) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Join_the_community-Discord-5865F2?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/hrTSX5yTpB) [Quick Start](#quick-start) · [Watch Demo](#demo) · [Supported Platforms](#supported-platforms)
